One sentence: a fresh looser-than-expected storage print, falling gas generation/power burn and a front-contract roll program outweigh the small supply-tightening offsets, while Friday structure should damp rather than reverse that pressure. No handed-down read exists for E.

INDEPENDENT CHAIN. Storage owns the cleanest bearish fundamental term: the Sep-11 print was +71 Bcf versus +68 final consensus and +66 strictly pre-print, with L48 +154.2 Bcf versus five-year and chg_vs_5yr_chg +5.6. I assign about -110 USD to the loose-storage/backdrop term. The demand stack independently leans bearish: US48 estimated gas burn is 37.8 Bcf/d, gas generation is down 759,759 MWh over seven days and gas share down 4.25 points, while wind is up 295,027 MWh and 2.79 share points; NGWU also says power demand -1.7 Bcf/d WoW. I assign about -110. STEO/weekly balance adds a slow -50 class: September power burn 39.23 Bcf/d is below August 45.54 and the monthly storage trajectory is injection-heavy. Supply offsets point the other way: dry production is stated -0.5 Bcf/d WoW, total supply -0.2, and nuclear outages are up 1.61 GW over seven days; together I give those about +70. The D-1 scored-leg tape is strongly sell: -3,844 lots on 106,027 volume, two-sided b-share 0.480, all three phase signed flows negative [-170,-3370,-304], and big-print b-share_two_sided 0.448. BUT GSCI/BCOM programs are live, so flow.resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt correctly tells me raw aggressor tilt is suspect. Its own later evidence also says the proposed residual-sign substitution is only 1-1 and the needed cohort decomposition is not served. I therefore do NOT invert the tape and do NOT use it as primary direction; I give the persistent same-side pressure only a small -70 corroboration term. Friday squaring/no in-session catalyst and the fact that the COT book is mid-range and IMPROVING damp the expression by about +50. The independent arithmetic lands near -320 rather than at a fitted band. vol_regime supports that scale without forcing it: n0 net sigma5/10 are 481/484, sigma20 754, prior-full-session range 1,090 and range percentile 41.2.

The emission-ceiling self-check does not bind: the derived 320 is below the ~450 trigger and was obtained by summing named opposing terms.

STEP 5 FALSIFIER / ANTI-DEFAULT. The strongest reason this DOWN read can fail is that the prior-session sell tape is mostly scheduled roll pressure and therefore transient, while production is tightening and nuclear outages are rising. A clean non-program buy handover late Friday would refute the carry mechanism. The second is the missing historical forecast-weather/stability plane: a genuine weekend demand revision can own the Sunday gap, but it is unavailable at this decision point and I will not synthesize it. The number is not 'small because Fridays are small'; it is moderate because several independent bearish terms coexist, then get partially offset by supply tightening and Friday squaring.

The continuous p50 path starts at zero from the Friday open and ends -270, exactly guessed_net_usd - overnight_gap_usd = -320 - (-50).
